## [1.18.0](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/compare/v1.17.11...v1.18.0) (2026-11-16)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Google Photos - Avatar,Notifications:** resolve v8 avatar click crash, restore Google One Blue Aura Ring, and suppress 24h notification nag ([#80](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/issues/80), [#81](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/issues/81)) ([1b30afc](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/1b30afc8fa22ae39dbbdea0784a2050f63448108))

* **Google Photos:** enable Compose Morphe settings entry unconditionally and index backup queries ([7d09a0a](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/7d09a0acdeae652a3a0f0fa80fee68af31bcdbf6))
* **Google Photos:** resolve tune icon dynamically and index skottie fingerprints ([aff2d57](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/aff2d57e33f57aee57f1fa3789842e9d6e252ba3))
* **Google Photos - Lens:** spoof authentic caller package for OneLens IPC handshake ([#77](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/issues/77)) ([d27dec4](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/d27dec4de071e9ccab9001a15b6602dea33a2ab7))

* **Google Photos:** mask modern pixel features for genuine pixels and preserve stock passthrough ([#75](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/issues/75)) ([d5cef7e](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/d5cef7e174f25726738a576368be59af56bbbd28))
* **Google Photos:** resolve status enum type for camera unbacked badge ([#75](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/issues/75)) ([c859ffa](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/c859ffa49ad0e797cae95e6ac6501de3bcf3ff19))
* **Google Photos - Release:** remove package.json release block and use .releaserc for dev prereleases ([12cbdf2](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/12cbdf23300707751cbdda38a1a4b4cd4e7f8c2d))
* **Google Photos - Toolkit:** restore 7.99.0 symbol candidates to support older app versions ([#73](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/issues/73)) ([408a3dc](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/408a3dc372db20921163b65003b50290f80b1518))

### ✨ New Features

* **Google Photos - Backup:** add "Upload photos only" toggle — skip videos in automatic backup ([#82](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/issues/82)) ([c1af957](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/c1af9571d3820bb9c1cb0b266d3928803883a2a0))
* **Google Photos - Engine:** render organic wavy scrapbook shapes and Google Sans typography for memory cards ([dac931c](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/dac931cae0875aa03cb186031623ae45720ddbcb))
* **Google Photos - Flags:** update base phenotype configuration to official Google Photos v8.0 snapshot ([e246d89](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/e246d89872c49e56d0134ccb66edbcdac36b59a4))
* **Google Photos - Gms:** enable MicroG-RE live Phenotype sync and remove hardcoded flag defaults ([7390ceb](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/7390ceb2b072520967cedc2660a5fe24463b5392))
* **Google Photos:** add support and fix fingerprints for 8.0.0.1011730683 ([2396a3b](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/2396a3b9cc32cb071788a5502caf42f4d7f4fb78))
* **Google Photos - Models:** add experimental support for low-tier phones in AI editing pipelines ([#72](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/issues/72)) ([72bfd1b](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/72bfd1bb1de36159fa96b2d30b8ce8731c8e6534))
* **Google Photos:** implement compact navigation bar in Morphe Settings ([#74](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/issues/74)) ([71f489e](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/71f489ebc4c124fd2ef119f958977cfa605fd6eb))

* **Google Photos - Compat:** next app version release ([e2cef9a](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/e2cef9a5439470f83dc7854ec429ddb6c8ea09ee))

* **Google Photos - Engine:** anchor Skottie font loader and uri resolver via class fingerprints ([5601466](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/56014664da91a781f3e605ef30a140f28fd8cbf7))
